title: The Last Echo Again
premise: Xanthe Voss, a xenolinguist whose mind has been quietly rewritten by decades of contact with alien signal-patterns, works the fringe routes where colonies have gone linguistically silent. When the freighter Meridian returns from deep space with its crew aged backward into children who speak a language that shouldn't exist, Xanthe recognizes it as the tongue of the Kessari—a species officially recorded as extinct, and one she helped erase. Digging for the truth of what happened aboard the Meridian and in the Kessari's final days, she finds every archive altered, every witness complicit or terrified, and her own memories edited to bury her role in the cover-up. As the Consortium moves to disappear her the way it disappeared the Kessari, Xanthe must choose between restoring her stolen past and broadcasting the massacre to every world still listening—ending with her sacrificing her own remaining human memories to encode the truth into a signal no power can unmake.
about_author: Felix Delacroix is the pen name of a former maritime radio operator who spent eleven years relaying traffic between isolated stations before turning to fiction. They write about distance, translation, and the people who keep talking when no one answers.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Xanthe Voss pilots a supply run through the Verge, translating dead colony beacons out of habit. POV: Xanthe. She dreams in a language she can't name and wakes unsettled. The beat is loneliness disguised as competence—establishing a woman who has made invisibility a profession.

chapters.title: Children of the Meridian
chapters.summary: Docking at Halcyon Station, Xanthe witnesses the Meridian arrive: forty crew reduced to children, physically de-aged, speaking in fluent Kessari. POV: Xanthe. She alone understands them—and realizes she shouldn't. Emotional beat: recognition and dread entwined; her buried past stirring.

chapters.title: Records of Nothing
chapters.summary: Xanthe petitions station authorities; the official log shows the Meridian never left port. POV: Xanthe, with a secondary scene from Consortium auditor Ivo Renk flagging her queries. Beat: gaslighting begins—the machinery of erasure revealing itself through paperwork.

chapters.title: What the Children Say
chapters.summary: Xanthe secretly interviews the de-aged crew, decoding fragments: a first-contact protocol, a quarantine order, screams rendered as grammar. POV: Xanthe. Beat: grief—she realizes the Kessari taught the crew their language as they died, a message smuggled through victims.

chapters.title: The Woman Who Signed It
chapters.summary: A decrypted fragment surfaces bearing Xanthe's own authorization code from twenty years ago. POV: alternating Xanthe and Ivo, who is ordered to contain her. Beat: betrayal of self—she must confront that she participated in the extinction's cover-up.

chapters.title: Hollow Archive
chapters.summary: Xanthe travels to the Consortium's memory vault on Ceres-9 seeking her original records, finding them surgically emptied. POV: Xanthe. An archivist hints others were edited too. Beat: horror curdling into resolve; the theme of corrupted power made institutional.

chapters.title: Renk's Offer
chapters.summary: Ivo corners Xanthe: restoration of her memories and a quiet life, if she recants. He reveals the Meridian was a salvage op looting Kessari ruins—and the de-aging is a weapon test gone visible. POV: Ivo, then Xanthe. Beat: temptation; belonging offered at the price of truth.

chapters.title: Signal Ghosts
chapters.summary: Xanthe decodes the children's full testimony: the Kessari weren't extinct—they were culled, and the weapon is being refined for use on dissenting colonies. POV: Xanthe. Beat: rising action peaks; she rallies the de-aged crew and two sympathetic archivists.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: Consortium forces board Halcyon to silence everyone. Xanthe hijacks the long-range array, weaving the Kessari testimony into a carrier wave no filter can strip without destroying all traffic. Climax: Ivo hesitates at the last moment, letting the transmission go. Beat: sacrifice and defiance.

chapters.title: The Last Echo
chapters.summary: The truth propagates across the network; colonies begin answering in Kessari. Xanthe, her human-language memories spent encoding the signal, remembers almost nothing—but the children teach her their words, one by one. POV: Xanthe. Resolution: belonging found not in a restored past but in a shared future voice.
